long_biography.plain_text:
Levi trained in industrial chemistry at the University of Milan before spending more than twenty-two years at Dow. He rose to lead its emulsion-polymers business, then continued that mandate at Styron after Bain Capital acquired the division. Ahlstrom later recruited him as president and chief executive, where he refocused the fiber-materials portfolio toward specialty products.

After a period leading the surface-treatment company Thermission, Levi joined Ferroglobe as chief executive and director in 2020. The group mines and manufactures silicon metal, ferroalloys and related critical materials. His role has centered on operational restructuring, balance-sheet repair and repositioning production for solar, battery and advanced-industrial markets. He also serves on Mativ's board, extending a career built around global materials technology.
